soal_06_stimulus_01.png.description: Graph with the vertical axis labeled "P" (arrow up) and the horizontal axis labeled "Q" (arrow right). The P axis has evenly spaced tick marks, two of which are labeled "P2" (upper) and "P1" (lower). The Q axis has evenly spaced tick marks, three of which are labeled "Q3", "Q1" and "Q2" (left to right). Three parallel straight tan lines slope downward to the right, each with green dots at regular intervals. A thick black curve starts as a horizontal segment at the P1 level to the left of D3, passes through the red dot "D3" and the red dot "D1", then bends upward and passes through the red dot "D2" (at the P2 level), continuing slightly above it. D3 lies on the left tan line, D1 on the middle tan line and D2 on the right tan line. Blue dashed lines: horizontal from P1 to D3; horizontal from P2 to D2; vertical from D3 down to Q3; vertical from D1 down to Q1; vertical from D2 down to Q2. No numeric values are printed.
